result.answer: The entity "Rosneft Oil Company" appears on the U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list: it closely matches "OPEN JOINT-STOCK COMPANY ROSNEFT OIL COMPANY" under the UKRAINE-EO13662, RUSSIA-EO14024 program. As a designated party it is subject to U.S. sanctions, its assets are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with it.
